THX, CCZ, QJZ and DYC are all variants of THE SAME ONE CHARACTER, not separate output characters. Compare ALL available specimens equally to understand the exact identity. Trace genuine writing-stroke trajectories as smooth controlled centerline curves. Draw these with exactly CONSTANT uniform thickness approximately 3% of the square canvas width, perfectly rounded caps and joins. No swelling, taper, pointed tips, brush pressure, serif, texture or outline of brush silhouettes. Keep essential branches, short marks, counters, attachments, separations and relative bar lengths explicit. Important small gaps must stay open.

ONE finished glyph centered in the central 70% of a square canvas with generous clear margins. Pure BLACK strokes on fully TRANSPARENT background. No text, labels, charts, grids, frame, four variants, reference copies, shadows, paper, backdrop, ornament or watermark. The structural reading aid below guides attention, while all four reference specimens remain the visual authority.

RIGHT TOP: an upright U-shaped cup closed by ONE near-top horizontal bar, with TWO short side tips protruding above that bar. Thus topcup has ONE connected white counter region with a detached ink dash inside; NOT two stacked box counters. From cupBOTTOM center, a straight central stem continues uninterrupted DOWN through the rest of rightfigure to lowermostend. LOWER: an inverted-U arch crosses/joins stem at its apex and has TWO downward outerlegs; centralstemcontinuesbetweenthemandendsalittlelower. Exactly THREE long bottomends onright plusTHREEonleft =SIX overall. KeepbothmiddleUarmsconnectedthroughcenter andbottomarchdistinctfromthem. Preservefreeinnerdash,continuousaxis,bothupwardarmsandallthreebottomcourses.
The little horizontal INSIDE the upper cup must stay FLOATING with visible gaps at both ends; do not turn it into a divider.
